about.title: From backend engineer to AI builder.
story: I'm a software engineer based in Vienna. I spent four and a half years at HCL Technologies building backend systems in C#/.NET, Python and SQL — first as an apprentice, then as a full-time engineer — while completing my degree at BITS Pilani in parallel.

Along the way I got hooked on AI: data pipelines for AI-based monitoring, a conference paper on machine learning for sustainable design, and a GenAI service-desk assistant for my capstone. Today I'm an IT Innovation Intern at the IAEA, building LLM agents and MCP integrations — and making sure they're deployed safely.
I'm now looking for an AI/ML or GenAI engineering role in Austria or Europe, where solid backend engineering meets modern AI.
about.ascentSub: My career, one camp at a time.
about.skillsSub: The tools I carry on every climb.
about.beyondText: When I'm not at a keyboard, I'm usually somewhere high. I've completed a Basic Mountaineering Course and trekked in the Himalayas — the patience and planning it takes carry straight over into engineering. I also care about sustainability, which is what drew me to my PLMSS research.
